question: Yonex-Sunrise All India Sub Junior Ranking Badminton Tournament 2023 was held at _________ in Bihar from 27th June to 2nd July 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gaya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Yonex-Sunrise All India Sub Junior Ranking Badminton Tournament 2023 was held at **Gaya, Bihar**, from **27th June to 2nd July 2023**.
 
• This prestigious tournament is organized annually to provide a platform for young badminton players to showcase their talent and compete at the national level.
 
• Gaya, a historically and culturally significant city in Bihar, served as the host for this event, drawing participants and badminton enthusiasts from across India.
 
• The tournament was conducted under the aegis of the Badminton Association of India (BAI), which oversees badminton tournaments nationwide.
 
• Such tournaments are crucial for identifying promising players and helping them prepare for future international competitions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhagalpur**

 
 
• Bhagalpur, known as the "Silk City of Bihar," is famous for its production of Tussar silk.
 
• Though it is a prominent city in Bihar, it did not host the Yonex-Sunrise All India Sub Junior Ranking Badminton Tournament 2023.
 
• Bhagalpur is also known for its historical significance and proximity to the **Vikramshila **University ruins.
 
 
 
• **Patna**
 
 
• Patna is the capital city of Bihar and a major hub for education, politics, and culture in the state.
 
• While Patna has hosted several sporting events in the past, it was not the venue for the Yonex-Sunrise All India Sub Junior Ranking Badminton Tournament 2023.
 
• Famous landmarks in Patna include the Golghar, **Patna Sahib** Gurudwara, and Bihar Museum.
 
 
 
• **Rajgir**
 
 
• Rajgir is a popular tourist destination in Bihar known for its historical and religious significance, especially in Buddhism and Jainism.
 
• It is home to sites like the Vulture's Peak and the ancient **Nalanda** University ruins.
